non_blocking.suggestion: Catch-all fallback: under Data plane precedence, a Route with only `match.when: "true"` ties at rank 5 (one constraint) with any other host-less, path-less Route that has one constraint, and rank 6 then breaks the tie by `metadata.name`. So 'lowest-ranked' is not guaranteed. State the condition: the catch-all must be the only Route without `hosts` and `path` on its listener, or it must sort last by name.
